comparison_basis: KITopen metadata links directly to the RADAR record vuyYifgxlfOuFrSP.
The RADAR record identifies DOI 10.35097/1187 and a 1,313,122,304-byte CC BY 4.0 archive.
The KITopen readme uses the same PRE3P1A_KIT_Dmm_ttK_DATA.zip package naming recorded in the existing frozen protocol.
The existing validation artifact already pins the same RADAR archive URL, byte count, license and package manifest.

decision.claim_boundary: This reconciliation prevents double-counting a catalog DOI as an independent experiment. It does not add station-to-vehicle, ESD, safety-distance, ignition, dispersion or emergency-response validation.
